# the first map of the world goes to A and into a frame
I A 0 minecraft:map*1
ED f1 0:0:00 1:1:ac02 2:6:00 3:8:00 4:8:00 5:8:00 6:20:00 7:1:00 8:12:05 9:7:01d60901003000 10:1:00
PKT A minecraft:map_item_data 
PKT B minecraft:map_item_data 
# A takes a copy of the map: it holds the map and gets its marker
PKT A minecraft:map_item_data 3400000001020108000c00000b05040000
PKT A minecraft:map_item_data 3400000001020108000c00000b05040000
PKT B minecraft:map_item_data 
# A goes to the nether with the map: the frame still counts A as a holder
PKT B minecraft:map_item_data 
# the map leaves the inventory of A: the frame keeps A as a holder
PKT B minecraft:map_item_data
